_readme: Source for the three tutorial Head Coach puzzles. Edit here, then run `npm run tutorials` to rebuild public/tutorials/headcoach/headcoach-*.json. Each step is applied to the previous answer. Steps the build understands: "+ 5", "- 5", "× 5", "÷ 5", "double it", "triple it", "half of it", "square it", "1/3 of it", "25% of it". It works out every answer and stops if one isn't a whole number.
